text: Android core goes Kotlin Multiplatform: Ktor, no javax.inject, iOS targets compile (B5)

B5 blockers found in the B1 review (2026-09-24), all in :core: java.util.UUID (6 sites) -> kotlin.uuid.Uuid; System.currentTimeMillis (~12 sites incl. LwwField defaults) -> a Clock interface or kotlin.time.Clock; ConcurrentHashMap (AccountSessions) and synchronized (SyncStatus) -> a lock or MutableStateFlow.update; java.net.URI (serverLabel) -> Ktor Url; java.text.Normalizer (NameOrder, via ListsRepo) needs expect/actual; ApiException extends IOException and SyncEngine matches IOException/SSLException -> own exception types mapped from Ktor; javaClass.simpleName -> ::class.simpleName; AppDb needs @ConstructedBy for non-Android targets. AppFormat/AppLocale are used only by :app and can move back instead of expect/actual. The design's interface names (BackgroundSync, Clock, DeviceId) differ from the code's (SyncTrigger, DeviceIdProvider, none): align the docs or the code. Robolectric-only-for-a-Context tests of :core code (SyncEngineTest, ListsRepoTest, ItemsRepoTest, AuthRepositoryTest, DtoTest) belong in :core once Room's JVM in-memory builder is used.
